run_interactive_viewer: run the HabitatSimInteractiveViewer with a scene file and optional physics enabled via argparse CLI
reconfigure_simulator: reconfigure the simulator to load a new scene or change settings using reconfigure_sim
recompute_navmesh: recompute the navigation mesh with default settings and agent dimensions via navmesh_config_and_recompute
create_mouse_grabber: create a MouseGrabber to manipulate rigid or articulated objects with physics constraints
render_batch_environments: render multiple environments in a grid using the batch renderer and ReplayRenderer
